subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Mr. Satterthwaite was __shrewd __enough to penetrate her meaning.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"shrewd"** means having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute. (चतुर)

 
 
• **Example:** The **shrewd** businessman managed to negotiate a very favorable deal.
 
 
 
• **"Smart"** refers to someone who is intelligent or astute, similar to being shrewd. (स्मार्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** She is very **smart** and always finds a way to solve difficult problems.
 
 

Therefore, the correct synonym is **Smart.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aged** (वृद्ध): Being of advanced age.

 
 
• **Example:** The **aged** man walked slowly with the help of a cane.
 
 
 
• **Funny** (मजेदार): Causing laughter or amusement.
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian told a very** funny** joke that made everyone laugh.
 
 
 
• **Innocent** (निर्दोष): Not guilty of a crime or offense; lacking experience with the world.
 
 
• **Example:** The child gave an **innocent** smile when asked if he took the cookie.
